research_question: Can a strictly prequential selector among the three already-frozen candidate rankers improve candidate_recall@30, and does that candidate-stage selection translate into better three-line portfolio outcomes under one unchanged deterministic allocator?
novelty_statement: E080/E081 compared fixed rankers; E082 measured their ranking dependence. None selected among the same frozen rankers at each target using only the preceding 50 target outcomes. This study adds one pre-registered past-only dynamic-selection rule, without adding features, changing ranker formulas, searching parameters, or changing the allocator.

rankers.CONSENSUS: Mean of the five existing component z-scores; descending score, then ascending number.
rankers.BORDA: Sum of the five existing component rank positions; ascending sum, then ascending number.
rankers.MIN_RANK: Ascending minimum of the five component rank positions; tie-break by ascending sum of component ranks, then ascending number.
rankers.cutoff_rule: For every target t, all features and all three rankers use only main-number draws 1..t-1.

dynamic_selector.warmup_targets: 401..450 inclusive; used only to seed the trailing performance window.
dynamic_selector.selection_metric: Mean candidate_recall@30 across the immediately preceding 50 target rounds, using each ranker's own cutoff-safe ranking made before that prior target.
dynamic_selector.selection_rule: At target t, select the ranker with the highest mean recall@30 over targets t-50..t-1. No target-t outcome is read before selection.

candidate_stage.miss_trace: For each omitted winning instance, preserve selected ranker and five component rank positions; do not store winning-number values, candidate lists, or TOP30 values.

portfolio_stage.allocator: Fixed top-18 rank partition: ranks 1-6, 7-12, and 13-18 become exactly three six-number lines.
portfolio_stage.geometry: Three pairwise-disjoint six-number lines; union18; pairwise line overlap 0 by construction.

exact_geometry_matched_null.method: Enumerate a,b,c in 0..6 and d=6-a-b-c with 0<=d<=27; probability weight C(6,a)C(6,b)C(6,c)C(27,d)/C(45,6).

inference.bootstrap: Two-sided percentile moving-block bootstrap; 4,000 replicates; 50-target contiguous blocks sampled with replacement; retain the final one-target remainder in every replicate.
inference.nonoverlapping_block_stability: 16 full non-overlapping 50-target blocks over 451..1250; retain target 1251 as a separate final one-target remainder.

guardrails: This is an exploratory historical rolling-origin study, not a clean holdout or prospective confirmation.
No target-t outcome may affect target-t ranker selection.
No Friday tuning, no fallback, and no candidate or purchase numbers may be shown to the user.
Do not transfer any historical five-line result or status to the three-line policy.
No model or allocator promotion unless all existing gates and prospective policy requirements are met.
No delivery log event because no numbers are to be displayed.
